name: HERMES
summary: Highly Efficient Robotic Mechanisms and Electromechanical System — a full-size humanoid from Sangbae Kim's lab built to test whole-body human-in-the-loop control. Its distinguishing idea is the balance-feedback interface: the robot's center of pressure is measured and pushed back onto the body of a human operator wearing a feedback rig, so the operator's own split-second reflexes stabilise the machine faster than any vision-based controller could. Under teleoperation it poured coffee, swung an axe to chop wood and handled a fire extinguisher.
notable: Balance-feedback teleoperation — the operator feels the robot's balance and reflexively corrects it
Borrowed human reflexes instead of computing recovery from camera data
Aimed at disaster response: a remote operator inhabiting the robot on site
